name: eternal-blocks
description: Eternal Blocks - a browser-based multiplayer voxel sandbox with one permanent shared world.

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:deploy -w apps/server && npm run build:web && node scripts/check-pages-build.mjs
